title: Gradle build fails if there is no src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/
body:
**Describe the bug**
While looking into reverting #2214 so that I could rebase #1986, I noticed that the Gradle build fails if there is no `src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/`. 

**Expected behavior**
Gradle build should work even if there are no `src/main/resources/META-INF/resources`.

**Actual behavior**
Gradle build fails, as shown below.

**To Reproduce**
This can easily be seen in the Quickstart, like this:

```
git clone https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts.git
cd quarkus-quickstarts/getting-started
rm src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/index.html
./gradlew clean build --stacktrace

> Task :quarkusBuild FAILED
building quarkus runner

FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.

* What went wrong:
Execution failed for task ':quarkusBuild'.
> Failed to build a runnable JAR

* Try:
Run with --info or --debug option to get more log output. Run with --scan to get full insights.
```
